front_knee_good: Your front knee is well aligned. Keep it there.
front_knee_too_straight: Bend your front knee a little more. Aim for about a 90-degree angle.
front_knee_too_bent: Your front knee is bent too deeply. Straighten it slightly.
arms_good: Your arms are well extended. Keep reaching through your fingertips.
left_arm_bent: Extend your left arm fully. Keep it parallel to the floor.
right_arm_bent: Extend your right arm fully. Keep it parallel to the floor.
torso_leaning_forward: Your torso is leaning forward. Bring it upright.
torso_leaning_back: Your torso is leaning back slightly. Bring it straight up.
rear_leg_good: Your rear leg is nicely straight. Well done.
rear_leg_bent: Straighten your rear leg. Press through your rear heel.
reposition_camera: Please step back so your full body is visible in the camera.
no_person: No person detected. Please step in front of the camera.
session_start: Hold the pose steadily. I will analyse your alignment.
